{
 "path": "programs/task-ab5fc8eb.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Join the diagonally aligned pair of 1 markers. A 6 marker on the
    # segment indicates the color to use for the connecting line.
    for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(pts):
        for r2, c2 in pts[i+1:]:
            dr, dc = r2-r1, c2-c1
            if abs(dr) == abs(dc) and dr != 0:
                sr = 1 if dr > 0 else -1
                sc = 1 if dc > 0 else -1
                line = [(r1+sr*k, c1+sc*k) for k in range(1, abs(dr))]
                color = 6 if any(grid[r][c] == 6 for r,c in line) else 1
                for r,c in line:
                    out[r][c] = color
    return out
"
}
